label: Quinces
location: Upper-left corner, hanging from a branch with leaves
description: A cluster of bright yellow citrus fruits (traditionally identified as quinces) with green leaves and a woody branch

label: Apples
description: A cluster of approximately 9 red and yellow-green apples suspended by thin strings in a net-like arrangement

label: Hanging Birds
location: Two small birds hanging from strings at top-center, between the apples and the large game birds
description: Two small dead birds suspended individually from thin strings near the top edge of the painting

label: Cane Birds
location: A stack of small birds impaled on a vertical cane/stick resting on the stone ledge at lower-left
description: A group of small dead birds skewered on a green cane, stacked vertically, resting on the ledge below the yellow fruits

label: Bamboo Cane
location: Vertically along the left edge, resting on the ledge and leaning against the niche wall
description: A thick, segmented, green bamboo stalk with visible nodes, used to skewer the small birds

label: Partridge
location: Hanging upside down, slightly right of center, from the top edge
description: A large, plump game bird with rich brown, grey-blue, and black-speckled plumage, suspended by a string

label: Cardoon
location: Dominates the right side of the ledge, curving upwards and leftwards
description: A very large, pale white to light purple-grey vegetable with numerous thick, fibrous stalks forming a dramatic crescent shape

label: Root Vegetables
location: Resting on the ledge at bottom-center, between the bamboo cane and the cardoon
description: A group of root vegetables including a reddish-purple carrot, an orange carrot with green tops, and two white radishes

label: Stone Ledge
location: Horizontal surface across the bottom third plus vertical walls on left and right edges
description: The stone niche structure including the horizontal shelf, front face, left wall, right wall, and artist signature area

label: Dark Void
location: Behind all objects, filling the upper and central parts of the painting
description: The deep, uniform dark background suggesting a void or enclosed dark space behind the hanging objects
